title: I'm 41. Here's What I'd Do If I Walked Into A Gym For The First Time
hook: If I walked into a gym for the first time today, I wouldn't bench press, I wouldn't squat, and I wouldn't do a two hour workout.
body: Only work out for 15 minutes, every day, and never, ever miss a day, even if it's just five or 10 minutes on a bad day. Day one, ride the bike for five minutes to warm up, then do the leg press, the chest press machine and the seated cable rows: one easy warm-up set of 10 to 15 reps and two working sets of 8 to 12, two to three seconds on the way down and then explode up. In weeks two to four, alternate that with workout B: lat pull downs, the shoulder press machine and the cable crunches. Still 15 minutes, machines and cables only. Walk between your sets, stretch after and not before, and remember nobody is watching you.
